You are continuing the EXISTING DrLinq implant intake test on branch drlinq-patient-v1-wip. Do NOT create a new project. Work only in this checkout. Change only drlinq-test/implant-intake.html unless absolutely required.

CURRENT STATE:
- The existing 7-step implant intake is working.
- Page 2 already supports upper/lower/both jaws and the numbered FDI tooth chart. KEEP that work intact.
- Real OPG/CBCT/intraoral sample assets already work. KEEP them intact.

GOAL:
Improve the existing step "سؤال اصلی و تماس" so a patient who may not know how to phrase an implant question can choose from a few useful READY-MADE questions, while still being able to type their own question.

REQUIRED UX:
1) On the existing question/contact step, above the current free-text question field, show a short section titled approximately:
   "دوست دارید دندانپزشک به کدام سؤال پاسخ دهد؟"
   Add one short helper line explaining that these are only suggested questions to help the patient phrase what they want to know; they are NOT a diagnosis or treatment recommendation.

2) Show 3–4 tappable preset question cards/buttons. They must adapt to the patient's earlier selection.

Primary adaptation by missingCount when available:
- For "۱ دندان":
  • "آیا ممکن است برای این ناحیه پیوند استخوان یا سینوس‌لیفت لازم باشد؟"
  • "هزینه تقریبی ایمپلنت و روکش این دندان چقدر می‌شود؟"
  • "درمان معمولاً چند جلسه و چه مدت طول می‌کشد؟"
  • "آیا امکان کشیدن و گذاشتن ایمپلنت در یک جلسه وجود دارد؟"

- For "۲ تا ۳ دندان" or "چند دندان":
  • "برای جایگزینی این دندان‌ها معمولاً چند ایمپلنت لازم است؟"
  • "آیا ممکن است پیوند استخوان یا سینوس‌لیفت لازم باشد؟"
  • "هزینه تقریبی کل درمان چقدر می‌شود؟"
  • "درمان معمولاً چند جلسه و چه مدت طول می‌کشد؟"

- For "نیم‌فک" or "فک کامل":
  • "برای این فک چه گزینه‌هایی مثل All-on-4 یا All-on-6 قابل بررسی است؟"
  • "آیا امکان داشتن دندان موقت در ابتدای درمان وجود دارد؟"
  • "هزینه تقریبی درمان این فک چقدر می‌شود؟"
  • "تا دندان موقت و دندان نهایی معمولاً چقدر زمان لازم است؟"

Fallback/adaptation when missingCount is empty because another initial problem was chosen:
- For a loose/broken/bad tooth being considered for implant, include useful questions such as whether extraction and implant can be done together, possible bone graft need, approximate cost, and treatment duration.
- For an existing implant problem, use relevant questions such as whether the implant may be repairable/preservable, what records are useful for evaluation, approximate correction cost, and likely treatment timeline.
- For denture replacement, favor full-arch/fixed-over-implant questions, cost, temporary teeth, and duration.

IMPORTANT: The interface must only PRESENT QUESTIONS for the dentist. It must never answer them, estimate treatment, diagnose, or imply that grafting/sinus lift/All-on-4 is actually indicated.

3) Interaction:
- Patient taps ONE preset question; selected state should be obvious and green, consistent with the current DrLinq UI.
- Tapping a preset should store that exact text in s.question and visually select it.
- Add a clear option/button: "سؤال دیگری دارم".
- When "سؤال دیگری دارم" is chosen, show/open the existing textarea and let the patient type freely.
- If the user starts typing a custom question, preserve it normally in localStorage.
- It is okay for the textarea to remain visible after a preset is selected if that is simpler and more stable, but the patient must be able to edit the selected text. Do not create a confusing duplicate question field.

4) Summary:
- Add the patient's selected/typed question to the final summary as a row labeled "سؤال بیمار".
- If no question was entered, show "—".
- Do not make a question mandatory; keep current name/mobile validation behavior unchanged.

5) Preserve all existing behavior:
- 7-step flow and progress
- page 1 problem/missing-count logic
- page 2 multi-jaw + independent area selection + numbered FDI SVG chart
- health questions
- OPG/CBCT upload/status
- all 5 intraoral photo examples and uploads
- name/mobile/city
- consent
- localStorage persistence
- mobile-first layout
- no backend change, no production data change

6) Stability/quality:
- Keep implementation simple and readable.
- Do not blank the page.
- Avoid fragile nested template syntax.
- Check HTML/JavaScript syntax after editing.
- Run the existing local tests. If appropriate, add only lightweight internal sanity checks in the HTML; do not redesign unrelated screens.

Return only after drlinq-test/implant-intake.html is changed and locally checked.
